text:
alex: Quick postmortem follow-up from the rolling cert issue last night. We saw a regional retry spike and some TLS handshake failures during the window.
maria: can we list concrete owners + short ETAs? want this in the runbook before the next maint window.
sre_tiffany: i'll own durability changes: make the cert rollout atomic across regions and add a TTL/propagation monitor. ETA: 2w. JIRA: NET-1722.
jon: i'll do a short-term routing tweak: prefer healthy origin paths during rollouts to reduce fanout. PR by Fri. JIRA: NET-1723.
julia: i'll add synthetic post-rollout validation checks (SNI/cert-subject + 1m latency sweep). add to CI so a bad rollout blocks. ETA: Tue.
ops_mark: need a temporary user-facing mitigation for retries — can we throttle retries or increase backoff temporarily around the job? who owns the feature flag?
maria: i'll take the feature flag, docs, and a small runbook note for comms. ETA: 48h. OPS-901.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled job: cert-rotator v2.8 -> v2.9 on 2024-11-07T02:00Z. dry-run at 2024-11-07T01:30Z.
sre_tiffany: added a PromQL alert draft to detect regional retry rate spikes: sum by(region)(rate(lb_retry_total[10m])) / sum by(region)(rate(lb_request_total[10m])) > 0.05 for 10m -> page sev2.
jon: saw BGP blips ~15s before the retry surge in logs, filing NET-1724 to investigate BGP withdraw timing and route convergence.
julia: validation job example:
```
curl -sS -I https://us-lb.example.internal/health -H "Host: app.example.com" --resolve app.example.com:443:10.1.2.3 | grep -i "subject:"
```
will add to rollout pipeline.
ops_mark: please paste a short action table (owner, jira, ETA) in this thread so I can copy to the incident doc.
alex: action table:
- sre_tiffany, NET-1722, atomic cert rollout + TTL monitor, 2w
- jon, NET-1723, routing preference patch, Fri EOD
- julia, NET-1725, post-deploy synthetics + CI gate, Tue
- maria, OPS-901, feature flag + runbook, 48h
- ops_mark, OPS-902, tenant comms and opt-out coordination, 24h
maria: uploaded runbook draft & comms note: https://confluence.redwood/internal/net-cert-rollout (internal). :thumbsup:
sre_tiffany: scheduling 30m sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to review acceptance criteria and test plan. invite out.
alex: thanks team. we'll use this thread as the action tracker. ping here with PR links or timeline slips. :white_check_mark:
